user.title: Moj Elektro Plus
user.description: Create an API token in Moj Elektro under Moj profil → Kreiraj žeton. The meter identifier (EIMM) is listed under Merilna mesta. Readings are delayed, usually until the next day.

data.name: Friendly name (optional)
data.sidebar: Show the Moj Elektro sidebar page

data_description.api_token: Stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage, never sent to the browser.
data_description.history_months: Up to 24. The API serves at most two years of history; it is downloaded in the background.
data_description.refresh_hours: Minimum 1 hour. Readings are published with a delay (usually the next day), so frequent polling does not make them live.
data_description.sidebar: One shared page for all meters.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the Moj Elektro token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for meter {meter_id} no longer works. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Enter a new token, or leave it empty to keep the current one. The meter cannot be changed; add another entry for another meter.

error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected. Create a new token in Moj Elektro (Moj profil → Kreiraj žeton).
error.meter_inaccessible: This token cannot access that meter, or the meter does not exist.
error.invalid_meter_id: Enter the meter identifier (EIMM) in the form 4-93571.
error.invalid_request: Moj Elektro rejected the request parameters.
error.timeout: Moj Elektro did not respond in time. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Moj Elektro is rate limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.service_error: Moj Elektro returned an error or an unexpected response. Try again later.

abort.meter_mismatch: This entry belongs to a different meter. Add a new entry instead.

entry_not_loaded.message: That Moj Elektro Plus entry is not loaded.

invalid_range.message: The end date is before the start date.

refresh_range.name: Refresh range
refresh_range.description: Re-download readings for a date range (Europe/Ljubljana days, both inclusive) to pick up corrections. Limited to the last two years.
